questions.question:
The equation \(e^{4 x}+8 e^{3 x}+13 e^{2 x}-8 e^x+1=0, x \in R\) has:

 

[JEE Main 2023, 31 Jan (Shift 2)]
options: Four solutions two of which are negative
Two solutions and only one of them is negative
questions.explanation:
Let

\(t=e^x\).

Then \(t>0\).

The equation becomes

\(t^4+8t^3+13t^2-8t+1=0\).

We factor the polynomial as

\((t^2+3t-1)(t^2+5t-1)\).

Indeed,

\((t^2+3t-1)(t^2+5t-1)\)

\(=t^4+8t^3+(15-2)t^2-8t+1\)

\(=t^4+8t^3+13t^2-8t+1\).

Therefore,

\(t^2+3t-1=0\)

or

\(t^2+5t-1=0\).

The roots of the first quadratic are

\(t=\dfrac{-3\pm\sqrt{13}}2\).

Since \(t>0\), only

\(t_1=\dfrac{-3+\sqrt{13}}2\)

is valid.

The roots of the second quadratic are

\(t=\dfrac{-5\pm\sqrt{29}}2\).

Again, only

\(t_2=\dfrac{-5+\sqrt{29}}2\)

is positive.

Now

\(\sqrt{13}<5\),

so

\(t_1<1\).

Also,

\(\sqrt{29}<7\),

so

\(t_2<1\).

Thus

\(0<t_1<1\)

and

\(0<t_2<1\).

Since

\(x=\log_et\),

both corresponding values of \(x\) are negative.

Therefore, the equation has exactly two real solutions and both are negative.

Hence the correct option is \(A\).

Hence the correct option is A.

Let the mean and standard deviation of marks of class \(A\) of 100 students be respectively 40 and \(\alpha(>0)\), and the mean and standard deviation of marks of class \(B\) of \(n\) students be respectively 55 and \(30-\alpha\). questions.explanation:
Using the combined mean, \(\dfrac{100(40)+n(55)}{100+n}=50\).

\(\Rightarrow 4000+55n=5000+50n\)

\(\Rightarrow n=200\)

Using the combined variance about the overall mean \(50\), \(\dfrac{100[\alpha^2+(40-50)^2]+200[(30-\alpha)^2+(55-50)^2]}{300}=350\).

\(\Rightarrow 100(\alpha^2+100)+200[(30-\alpha)^2+25]=105000\)

\(\Rightarrow 300\alpha^2-12000\alpha+90000=0\)

\(\Rightarrow \alpha^2-40\alpha+300=0\)

\(\Rightarrow (\alpha-10)(\alpha-30)=0\)

\(\Rightarrow \alpha=10\) or \(\alpha=30\)

For \(\alpha=10\), the sum of the variances is \(10^2+(30-10)^2=100+400=500\), which is Option A.

For \(\alpha=30\), the sum of the variances is \(30^2+(30-30)^2=900+0=900\), which is Option D.

Both values satisfy \(\alpha>0\), and the corresponding standard deviation \(30-\alpha\) is non-negative in both cases.
